articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has proposed a change that could reshape how NBFCs design their lending products. Draft Amendment Directions issued on August 6, 2026 would restrict NBFCs to offering only term loans, with revolving credit permitted solely for RBI-authorized credit card issuers. Comments on the draft closed on August 28, 2026, and the rule takes effect only once formally notified. articles.title: RBI's Proposed Ban on Revolving Credit: What NBFCs Need to Watch
